query:
SELECT
            fv.replication_state,
            rj.status AS job_status,
            rj.attempt_count,
            rj.next_attempt_at,
            rj.last_attempt_at,
            rj.last_error
        FROM file_versions fv
        LEFT JOIN replication_jobs rj
            ON rj.file_version_id = fv.id
        WHERE fv.file_id = $1
          AND fv.version_number = $2
        ORDER BY rj.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
        LIMIT 1
